appRoot.description: PREFERRED: selector of the app's outermost container to clone whole (e.g. #lcnc-dashboard). Captures ALL chrome — every rail/bar — with the app's own layout, no reassembly guesswork.

dataRegion.description: Selector of the record-bearing region inside appRoot to PRUNE and replace with the empty content slot (e.g. the test-list table). Excluding it by construction keeps customer records out of the capture.

topbar.description: Legacy/fallback: top bar selector (only used if appRoot is absent).

regions.description: Any additional chrome regions to keep (e.g. a product rail) when NOT using appRoot.

contentSlot.description: CSS class of the empty content region where explorations mount (e.g. lca-main-slot). Used by the assembler.

shellSync.description: Fields shell-sync's onboard needs (maps to its profile). Optional; fill to generate a ready onboard JSON.

ticketPrefix.description: Jira project key, e.g. LCNC / LT / LCAM

productSignals.description: Words marking this product's work in shared repos
